claims.result: CO brightening, broad lines (up to 7.5 km/s) and redirected stream at the overlap zone
claims.finding: The outflows are probably partially colliding

evidence.quote: the outflows in the BHR 71 region are probably colliding

claims.hypothesis: Collision likelihood for close wide binary flows
claims.result: Probability near 1 for BHR 71; 0.2 and 0.5 for IC 1396N and G028.37
claims.finding: Collisions may be more common than observed

evidence.quote: the probability of collision is very close to 1, regardless of the orientation of the flows

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Redshifted emission from IRS 1 outflow exiting its cloud; rejected as unable to explain all facts; projection overlap also noted

evidence.quote: this hypothesis cannot explain some of the observational facts

limitations_admitted.value: Dust masses are lower limits with up to factor of two or three uncertainty

evidence.quote: The actual uncertainty could be very large (a factor of two or three)
These results may suggest that both outflows are colliding or just overlapping in projection.

referee_caveats_inferred: Evidence is morphological and kinematic; the collision is not quantified (no momentum or energy analysis).
Projection overlap is not rigorously excluded.
The probability model assumes sky-plane sizes are true sizes and ignores the outflow's actual shape.

reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public and the pipeline is simple, but many imaging parameters are unstated and the results are mostly qualitative.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main results are qualitative morphology and kinematics, and the recipe is incomplete.
